get.summary: Fetch all clients.
List all the allocation specifications.

Fetch all entities.

Fetch effective date types.

delete.summary: This endpoint delete Taxcode Mapping from the system.

Fetch all transaction type maps.

This endpoint is used to fetch the list of all datasets present including detailed information like Period, Entities, Templates, Created by etc etc.

get.summary: This endpoint is used to fetch the information like Entities, Period, Start and End dates, Jurisdictions, Return details etc of a given dataset.
This endpoint is used to fetch the status (Pass/Fail/InProgress) of created Dataset.
This endpoint is used to fetch the status (InProgress/Failed/Deleted) of delete Dataset operation.
